title: SPHERE Virtual Lab (SPHEREVL) & Control Room v2: Interactive 3D Acoustic Metrology, LDV & VNA Telemetry Simulator for Protocol LOC-1
description:
SPHERE Virtual Lab (SPHEREVL) / Control Room v2 is an open-source, interactive 3D metrology simulation environment and instrument telemetry suite engineered for Project S.P.H.E.R.E. and Protocol LOC-1.

Deployed live at https://lab.spheredesci.org and documented at https://spheredesci.org/vl/, this application simulates non-contact high-Q acoustic resonance tracking above 230 kHz in a precision-machined hollow copper sphere. It models phase-locked Vector Network Analyzer (VNA) sweeps, 3D Laser Doppler Vibrometry (LDV) modal readouts, Rubidium atomic frequency reference timing, matched reference artifact common-mode drift cancellation, and Two One-Sided Tests (TOST) statistical equivalence evaluation.
